cay_captain.text: I've been running the sandbar for thirty years. The rays are better company than most customers and a lot cheaper to feed.
If you want a quest, find me on the quay outside.

cay_deckhand.text: Squid in the bucket, rope on the cleat, life jackets on the customers. Nobody has ever been stung. You get a feeling for it. Also the rays are very polite.
They like being stroked, if you're gentle. Their skin is like wet velvet.
